question: Should experimental Claw lifecycle diagnostics be accepted as a core `openclaw doctor` contribution, rather than remaining outside the core Doctor surface until the broader Claws lifecycle stack is approved?
rationale: The patch is technically evidenced, but whether a cross-cutting lifecycle ledger and Gateway-backed diagnostics belong in core Doctor is a product and ownership decision that code review cannot infer.

options.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostic
options.body: Accept the experimental core Doctor boundary, require the small documentation correction, and review or land the stacked lifecycle prerequisites in order.

options.title: Keep Claw diagnostics outside core Doctor
options.body: Pause or close this slice until maintainers choose an external/plugin or otherwise narrower diagnostic surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the gated core diagnostic
recommendation.body: Accept the experimental core Doctor boundary, require the small documentation correction, and review or land the stacked lifecycle prerequisites in order.

likelyOwner.reason: The timeline shows direct engagement with this experimental core feature review, making this the strongest available routing signal for the remaining scope decision.
